Name: Catcrows for Content Patcher and Alternative Textures
Author: altroquinine
Description:
[i]Edit 1/25/25: I'm currently in my last semester of college and have been incredibly busy, so I haven't touched this mod in a long time. As of right now, this mod and all my others are on hiatus. I am aware there have been a couple issues with the textures bugging out, but I'm granting permission to edit the code and fix them, as well as any that may pop up in the future. My only request is that you don't claim the entire mod as your own, especially since it uses assets from two other people that are not me.[/i]

This mod converts [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1415]DocSaturn's Catcrows[/url] into a content pack for CP and AT. It's 1.6 compatible and fully configurable! I've copied the original description DocSaturn provided below, with an edit to the instructions :)

My lovely partner, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/174554346]Squishroom[/url], has sprited four new cats for the deluxe scarecrow! They are listed below.
[color= rosybrown]Norwegian Forest Cat[/color] - Replaces the regular deluxe scarecrow.
[color= paleturquoise]Galaxy Cat[/color] - Its eyes shine like stars. Replaces the themed deluxe scarecrow.
[color= mediumpurple]King of Cats[/color] - Based off a folktale from the British Isles. Replaces the themed deluxe scarecrow.
[color= red]N[/color][color= orange]y[/color][color= yellow]a[/color][color= lime]n[/color] [color= cyan]C[/color][color= magenta]a[/color][color= hotpink]t[/color] - An internet classic! Replaces the themed deluxe scarecrow.

[line]
Are crows all too happy to pick on your crops? Are the regular scarecrows not adorable enough for you? Do you feel like you need more
furry feline friends on your farm?  Fear not, these catcrows are here to
help!

These friendly felines come in two varieties: regular cats and themed cats.  Both sets come with a png so you can combine them
with other craftables without taking the extra step of extracting them![b][u]
[/u][/b]
[center][b][u]Instructions:[/u][/b][/center][b][u]
[/u][/b][list]
[*]Download ﻿[i]CP_Catcrows.zip [/i]or [i]AT_Catcrows.zip[/i] from the files tab
[*]Extract the file into your Stardew Valley mods folder
[*]If using CP, configure the mod in-game using GMCM or in the config.json. If using AT, configure the mod in-game using Alternative Textures through GMCM.
[*]Enjoy your catcrows!
[/list][i]
[/i][center][b][u]Future plans:[/u][/b][/center]
[list]
[*][s]Make compatible with alternative textures[/s] ✅
[/list][center][b][u]About the Cats[/u][/b][/center][b][u]
Regular Cats[/u]

[/b][color= #f9cb9c]Orange Tabby[/color] - Replaces the regular scarecrow.
[color= #ffe599]"Peaches", or Tan Spotted[/color] - Replaces the spring scarecrow (ladycrow).
[color= #dd7e6b]Chocolate cat with Dark Brown Boots[/color] - Replaces the fall scarecrow (witch).
[color= #b6b6b6]Black Tuxedo[/color] - Replaces the summer scarecrow (Radishhead).
Solid White - Replaces the winter scarecrow (snowman).
[color= #f6b26b]Tortoiseshell Cat[/color] - Replaces the casino scarecrow (alien).
Calico - Replaces the Dwarf scarecrow.
[color= #cccccc]Gray Tabby[/color] - Replaces the scarecrow you get when you donate 20 artifacts to the museum (raccoon).
[color= #dbb0a7]Seal Point[/color] - Replaces the scarecrow you get when you donate 40 artifacts to the museum (tiki head).

[b][u]Themed Cats

[/u][/b][color= #f6b26b]Nekomata/Lucky Cat[/color] - brings prosperity to the farm by driving away evil crows.  Replaces regular scarecrows.
[color= #8ab576]The summer Luau cat[/color] - a hard working dancer cat who keeps crops crow-free with her lovely
dances.  Replaces the Radishhead/Summer Scarecrow you can get at the Stardew Valley Fair.
[color= #a79cc5]The witchy fall cat[/color] - adds a little magic to your farm in addition to looking cute. I couldn't keep radishhead, so I made it look like Gigi for the Studio Ghibli reference!  Replaces the Fall Witch scarecrow you can get at the Halloween event.
[color= #aac89e]The  Out of this World Cat[/color] - it came here to scare crows and chill out from the far far away cat's eye galaxy.  I'm not a fan of regular green guy aliens, but boy do I love cat aliens.  Cookie cat was my other idea but I think I prefer this guy's color scheme more.  Replaces the Alien bought at Qi's casino.
[color= #dd7e6b]The Winter Bundled Up Cat[/color] - No cold will deter this festive kitty.  Replaces the winter snowman scarecrow bought from the traveling saleswoman during fall and winter.
[color= #ea9999]The Spring Cherry Blossom Cat[/color] - A gentle cat in a season full of turbulent weather.  Inspired by cherry blossom Miku Hatsune! Replaces the spring scarecrow you can get at the Flower Festival.
[color= #8e7cc3]The Iridium Cat[/color] - doesn't provide iridum, but sure looks swell next to that statue grandpa gave you!  Replaces the Dwarfcrow you can buy from the dwarf.
[color= #dbb0a]Adventure Archaeologist Cat[/color] - Not only does he defend your crops, he kindly reminds you that any
artifact you just found belongs in the museum.  Replaces the Raccoon Scarecrow Gunther Gives you after you turn in 20 artifacts at the museum.
[color= #6fa8dc]Bast[/color] - the cat goddess can only be earned after 40 artifacts are donated to the museum, impressed by your riches.  Replaces the Tiki Head Scarecrow you get
after you donate 40 artifacts to the museum.
[u][b]

[/b][/u]You can contact me on [url=https://artfromsaturn.tumblr.com/]artfromsaturn.tumblr.com[/url] if you have any questions or trouble using them. c:
[line]
[left][i][center]I have gotten permission from DocSaturn to upload this mod. DocSaturn, please let me know if you would like me to take it down for any reason. Everyone else, please let me know if there's any issues - it's my first time making a content pack for Stardew! You can contact me on [url=https://altroquinine.tumblr.com]altroquinine.tumblr.com[/url] :)[/center][/i][/left]
